items.text:
1.0 is "out" and it is a major disappointment, because it was shipped as much care as a student would in high school, half assed, just enough to get by.
There have been already discussions here on the steam forums with hot garbage takes, only love and positivity is accepted not negative criticism.
They set a date and when it came, called it 1.0 and "promised" to put time on it for another year... so 7 years?

Literally just updating the review to get rid of the EA review sticker, not like much got changed anyway, content locked behind a 30 h grind.

The worst tutorial drifts the beginner ship into the nearest planet, even noclipping into it to the point where you are constantly crashing INSIDE a planet.

Fought a pirate and they don't get exhausted and can fight for eternity, they even trained their unarmed skill to max on me... so wtf should I have done?
You know how I knew, I loaded back and it eventually revealed to me that they are training for it at 1 %.
Not only that, but they had red text in their profile which gave them infinite oxygen, so my plan of venting the ship and destroying their helmet didn't even work, because of an oversight???

This whole game got oversighted the moment updates were in the bits size, the update logs took probably more size than the actual updates sometimes.

♥♥♥♥ this game honestly, the combat sucks ass, fighting a pirate and we are both exhausted, then why in the ♥♥♥♥ can they do tackles and normal attack moves, meanwhile I can only do tired moves and 0 tackles, they love to spam that ♥♥♥♥ too or when they are out of range they throw a fit and only dodge and block.
Don't bother with combat, train it on some ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ meat and just one shot whoever you see with ease.
I have literally a bland character, no skills and no debuffs, just like the pirate and they get the dev console.
Pirate "barely" affected my armor with their knuckleduster jab = 50 % condition of an EVA suit.

This is just not right, stop defending slop, stop ragebaiting, stop being unreal.

Can't even close itself right, gotta delete it most of the times with task manager.

Why are explosions and fire not immediately turn the game speed to one?
So either I repair and wait real life minutes for several conduits or repair in space.
The game also loves to ♥♥♥♥ itself once you have multiple things, but not the required item for, now put that into 16x speed, autotask and there goes the fps into the single digits.

I also love, how they didn't give any clue what the other EVA suits do, even they planned to add more and yet they do with the same description most likely, because I haven't encountered a new one yet.

Can't even starve to death.
Oh, but you can overeat and that is apparently the same as starving???

Having to babysit my character on autotask, because they thought it would be fine to eat space meat instead of the food that I bought, maybe it still has no effect as it did in early access, but if it does, then autotask is unreliable.

Funny how even the second trailer lags.

Doesn't prioritize better tools, had to literally delete worse tools and it didn't tell me, so I wasted time for no good reason.

The EVA helmet has a weird line on the left side which doesn't connect, it is so obvious to see.

Went on a killing spree and then suddenly it changed my character with clothes even though I have non on since they literally don't do anything

Got docked by the police, paid the fine, then they just docked off with me on the ship and then it ♥♥♥♥♥♥ up my ship and their, meanwhile both me and the cop are heavily damaged, so why do they have to dock you with a speed of 1000 km/h and dock off with the same speed???
items.text_zh:
1.0 已经“发布”了，这真是令人大失所望，因为它被交付时的用心程度就跟高中生做作业一样，敷衍了事，只求勉强过关。
Steam 论坛上已经有过讨论了，都是些垃圾观点，只接受爱与正能量，不接受负面批评。
他们定了个日期，到了那天就管它叫 1.0，还“承诺”再花一年时间打磨……所以是 7 年？

真的就只是更新一下评测，好去掉抢先体验评测的标签，反正也没改多少东西，内容还锁在 30 小时的肝度后面。

最烂的新手教程会把新手船漂移到最近的行星上，甚至穿模进去，导致你不停地在一个行星内部坠毁。

跟一个海盗打，他们不会累，可以永远打下去，他们甚至在我身上把徒手技能练到了满级……所以我他妈该怎么办？
你知道我怎么知道的吗，我读档回去，它最终向我揭示他们是以 1% 的速度在训练。
不仅如此，他们的个人资料里还有红色文字，给了他们无限氧气，所以我抽空飞船、打爆他们头盔的计划根本没用，就因为一个疏忽？？？

这整个游戏从更新变成零碎小补丁的那一刻起就全是疏忽，更新日志有时候占的空间可能比实际更新还大。

说实话，去他妈的这游戏，战斗烂得一塌糊涂，跟海盗打，我俩都精疲力尽了，那他妈为什么他们还能做擒抱和普通攻击动作，而 meanwhile 我只能做疲惫动作和 0 次擒抱，他们还特别喜欢狂刷那玩意儿，或者当他们超出范围时就发脾气，只闪避和格挡。
别费劲搞战斗了，拿些他妈的肉练一练，然后轻松秒掉你看到的任何人。
我的角色真的平平无奇，没技能也没减益，就跟那海盗一样，可他们却有开发者控制台。
海盗用指虎刺拳“勉强”影响我的护甲 = EVA 服 50% 的耐久度。

这根本不对，别再为垃圾辩护了，别再煽动愤怒了，别再脱离现实了。

连自己都关不干净，大多数时候得用任务管理器删掉它。

为什么爆炸和火灾不立即把游戏速度降到一档？
所以我要么修理，然后为几条管道等现实生活中的几分钟，要么在太空里修。
这游戏还特别喜欢在你有多样东西但没有所需物品时崩溃，现在把它放到 16 倍速、自动任务，然后帧率就掉到个位数了。

我还很喜欢，他们完全没给任何线索说明其他 EVA 服有什么用，即使他们计划添加更多，而且很可能还是用同样的描述，因为我还没遇到过新的。

连饿死都做不到。
哦，但你可以吃撑，而且这显然跟饿死是一样的？？？

得在自动任务时照看我的角色，因为他们觉得吃太空肉而不是吃我买的食物没问题，也许它还是像抢先体验时那样没效果，但如果有的话，那自动任务就不可靠。

好笑的是，连第二个预告片都卡。

不会优先使用更好的工具，我不得不真的删掉更差的工具，它也没告诉我，所以我白白浪费了时间。

EVA 头盔左侧有一条奇怪的线，没有连接上，太明显了。

进行了一场杀戮狂欢，然后突然它给我的角色换上了衣服，尽管我根本没穿，因为它们真的什么用都没有

被警察扣留了，付了罚款，然后他们就带着我在船上扣留离开了，然后它搞砸了我的船和他们的船，同时我和警察都受了重伤，那为什么他们必须以 1000 公里/小时的速度扣留你，又以同样的速度扣留离开？？？
然后它♥♥♥♥♥♥了我的船和他们的船，与此同时我和警察都受了重伤，那为什么他们必须以1000公里/小时的速度对接，又以同样的速度脱离？？？
